source_text:
Ὑακίνθου χυλὸς
ἐγχυματιζόμενος παντὶ θηρίῳ ἀντιπαθεῖ. Ἡ τε τοῦ ἀγρίου σταφυλίου ῥίζα
περιαπτομένη καὶ ὁ καρπὸς ἐγχυματιζόμενος ἁρμόζει πρὸς πᾶν θηρίου δῆγμα καὶ
πληγάς.
pass_a_gloss: Of-hyacinth juice being-drenched to-every beast is-antipathic. The both of-the-wild grape-plant root being-hung-around and the fruit being-drenched they-fit toward every of-a-beast bite and strikes.
pass_b_english: Juice of hyacinth, being drenched, is antipathic to every beast. Both the root of the wild grape-plant, hung around, and the fruit, being drenched, fit toward every bite of a beast and strikes.

choices.why: ἀντιπαθέω is a counter to the venom of every beast, not 'suffers with every beast'.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
